approval_status: Sean renamed the existing swarm Gnatastrophe on2026-10-23 for Prototype96; stable ID unchanged
description: A tight cloud of tiny sewer flies with an unfortunate habit of drifting into everyone’s way. They wander slowly without hunting, and contact harms plumbers and monsters alike.

magazine_backstory.text: A maintenance crew first reported Gnatastrophe as a swarm circling a blocked vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.
magazine_backstory.canon_note: Current name selected by Sean October23; historical aviation-flavored backstory remains a draft, not approved new lore or mechanics.

quirk.text: An absurdly self-important air force with no flight plan or identifiable commanding officer.
quirk.mechanics_constraint: Slow random non-hunting movement and incidental contact damage remain unchanged. No guns, projectiles, pursuit, uniforms or new animation required.
